title: Chocolate and Orange Bun Pudding
rawIngredients: 1 tsp vanilla bean paste (or vanilla extract)
method: Heat the oven to 160°C / gas mark 3. Halve the hot cross buns horizontally and arrange the bottoms in a 1.5-litre baking dish.
Gently warm the milk, cream, orange zest, vanilla, and optional Cointreau in a small saucepan.
Whisk the eggs and sugar together in a mixing bowl, then gradually temper with the warm cream mixture.
Scatter two-thirds of the chopped chocolate over the bottom bun halves and pour half the custard over them.
Cover with the bun tops, press down gently, pour over the remaining custard, and let stand for 30 minutes to absorb.
Scatter the remaining chocolate on top and bake for 35–45 minutes until the custard has just set and the crust is golden.
